description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5915013536609 FILTER ASSEMBLY,ELE: Line 0001 Qty 20 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0124 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
